headline: NRB Industrial Bearings confirms non-applicability of related party transaction disclosures
summary: NRB Industrial Bearings has informed the stock exchange that the disclosure of related party transactions under Regulation 23(9) of SEBI LODR Regulations is not applicable to the company. This exemption applies for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Such filings are routine procedural compliances for eligible listed entities. For an Indian retail investor, this carries no direct financial impact on the company's earnings or stock valuation.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price.
